_comment: "CHOOSE 1 OR BOTH; banish target INSTANT from an opposing hero's graveyard / banish target YELLOW CARD from an opposing hero's graveyard." Three things. `choose: 1` with no choose_max made "or both" impossible -- the card could only ever take one mode. Both modes were BANISH_REF, which acts on a ref an earlier effect stored and no effect here stores one, so neither mode did anything. And their restrictions were effect-level `conditions`, which gate WHETHER the effect runs rather than filtering WHICH card it takes -- with card_type "YELLOW", which is a COLOUR and matches no type at all.
